user_duration_override: Latest user message replaces 8 hours with 10 hours

lanes.A: NEXT_Q_EPS: next fiscal-quarter GAAP diluted EPS
lanes.C: FUTURE_TTM_EPS: sum of four fiscal-quarter EPS on a common origin share basis, with approximation/eligibility explicit

currency: USD, separate currency identities; no implicit FX conversion
fact_vintages: accession-bound first-reported truth; features use only versions available at forecast origin
availability: Reuse existing XNYS PIT calendar contract; when precise accepted timestamp is absent use a declared conservative next-session availability, never invent a timestamp
fiscal_index: derive from actual fiscal period boundaries and filing metadata, not a calendar-quarter assumption
q4_policy: Do not label annual EPS minus 9-month EPS as exact diluted Q4 EPS. Inferred/approximate Q4 belongs to a separately labeled research surface, never silently mixed with direct observations.
split_policy: Historical splits through origin may normalize features; future splits may normalize evaluation labels ONLY. Missing basis provenance fails combination closed.
input_selection: All data geometry, target construction, temporal boundaries and candidate specifications must be locked before model scoring. Existing fresh reserves and heldout forbidden.
training: Global multi-entity panel; chronological expanding split, all training labels available strictly before fit cutoff
foundation_pretraining: Checkpoint pretraining data/cutoff and possible historical overlap must be recorded. Unknown pretraining contamination prevents strict PIT-certified claims even when inference is causal.
selection: Validation/OOF only; research-test scores are descriptive and cannot tune same-identity parameters or ensemble weights
quantiles: Only real model quantiles; unsupported quantiles null
pe_combination: Future TTM EPS times expected PE at origin; STATIC_PE_HOLD_ASSUMPTION and HORIZON_MISMATCH_LIMITATION. Nonpositive EPS, invalid PE, timestamp/currency/share/definition mismatch fail closed.
environments: New isolated EPS environments only; PE venv/system Python/CUDA drivers/conda base unchanged
external_sources: Official repos/packages, commit/version/license/weight hashes; inspect remote code before execution
